name: pixelox
description: Skills for driving the pixelox image workstation CLI (layers, masks, adjustments, filters, type, shapes, styles, templates, SVG, batches, local AI), for portrait retouching (blemishes, frequency separation, natural skin smoothing), for graphic design from a brief (posters, flyers, ads, covers, social posts built from a library of studied designs and tested effect recipes), and for infographics and data graphics (charts, maps, dashboards, timelines, process diagrams built from data with tested chart generators).
